capabilities: insert a page break via a configurable hotkey
insert a page break via the /break slash command
apply page breaks during PDF export
extras: The README's before/after demonstration consists only of images, so the exact visual result of the break is not described in text.
problem: Obsidian's PDF export has no built-in shortcut for inserting page breaks between exported pages.
summary: Page-break inserter that adds a hotkey and command to place page breaks in notes for PDF exports.
